div.note: Na. 150. Taa za Barabarani Mji Mkuu wa Dodoma

u.seg: Kwa kuwa Mji wa Dodoma hatimaye umekuwa ni Makao Makuu ya Serikali na kwa kuwa mara nyingine wageni hufika Dodoma nyakati za usiku kwa ajili ya shughuli zao mbalimbali.
Je, Serikali itaanza lini kuweka taa za barabarani katika Mji wa Dodoma?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Dr. Suleiman Juma Omar, Mbunge wa Mikunguni, kama ifuatavyo:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Serikali za Mitaa, Mamlaka za Miji namba 8 kifungu 55 (1) (h) ya mwaka 1982, Halmashauri za Miji zinalo jukumu la kuweka taa za barabarani kwenye maeneo ya mitaa yao. Huduma hii hufanywa kwa kuweka taa, nguzo, mikonga na taa na vifaa vinginevyo na pia kufanya matengenezo ya mara kwa mara.

Mheshimiwa Spika, Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Dodoma ilianza kutoa huduma ya taa za barabarani mwaka 1982 na kwamba kutokana na sababu mbalimbali huduma hii hivi sasa haitolewi. Maeneo yaliyowahi kupatiwa huduma hii ni Mitaa ya Madukani eneo la Kati ya Mji, Makole NHC, Uzunguni Kazembo, Majengo, Uhindini, Mwangaza, Kilimani, Image, Kiwanja cha Ndege (Airport). Maeneo mengine ni barabara za kuelekea polisi, Mji mpya, Iringa, Mirembe, Dar es Salaam, Kiwanja cha Jamhuri na barabara ya Bahi kuelekea Nkuhungu.
Mheshimiwa Spika, Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Dodoma imeshindwa kutoa huduma hii kwa sababu kubwa mbili zifuatazo:-

(a) Kuharibika kwa miundombinu ya taa za barabarani hususan vifaa kama taa, mikonga ya taa, nguzo na mashine za kuwasha na kuzima zinazojiendesha zenyewe ambavyo Halmashauri ya Manispaa imeshindwa kuvifanyia matengenezo. Mwaka 2002 Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Dodoma ilifanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya taa za barabarani kwa maeneo yaliyokuwa yanapata huduma hiyo na maeneo mengine mapya.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa mujibu wa tathmini hiyo, jumla ya shilingi 65,027,682/= zitahijika katika kuweka taa za barabarani. Gharama ambazo kwa sasa ni kubwa kwa Halmashauri hii ilikinganishwa na uwezo wake.
(b) Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Dodoma ina madai kutokana na statuary contributions zinazofikia kiasi cha shilingi milioni 700. Kwa hiyo, kwa sasa imetoa kipaumbele katika kulipa madeni hayo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, mwisho Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Dodoma inatambua umuhimu wa huduma ya taa za barabarani katika maeneo mbalimbali katika mji huu hivyo huduma hii itarejeshwa mara tu hali yake ya kiuchumi itakapokuwa imetengemaa.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ahsante sana kwa kunipa nafasi hii.
Pamoja na majibu ya Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri, kwa kuwa kama nilivyoeleza wageni wengi sasa hivi Dodoma na wakati mwingine wanafika time za usiku.
(a) Waziri haoni kwamba wageni wengi hawawezi kufika mahali wanapotaka kwa sababu hawaoni mbao za kuongoza barabara kwa kwenda kwa sababu hakuna taa?
(b) Kama Wizara ya Tawala za Mikoa na Serikali za Mitaa ni in charge wa Halmashauri. Je, Wizara yenyewe inasema nini juu ya tatizo hili ambalo linasitisha Maendeleo ya Mji wa Dodoma?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu maswali ya Mheshimiwa Dr. Suleiman Juma Omar, kama ifuatavyo:-
La kwanza, kama nilivyosema hali halisi ndiyo hiyo kwa hiyo, wageni watakapokuwa hapa Dodoma basi tutakwenda na hali halisi kama ilivyo kwa sababu sasa hatuna namna nyingine ya kuweza kufanya.

Mheshimiwa Spika, pili, Wizara inasemaje kuhusu suala hili? Suala hili kama nilivyosema liko entirely tayari chini ya Mamlaka za Halmashauri ya Manispaa ya Dodoma, sana sana tunachoweza kufanya ni pale tutakapokuwa tumepata mashauriano nao tunaweza pengine kusaidiana kutafuta ufadhili wa namna moja au nyingine. Lakini kama Wizara hatuna Bajeti ambayo ingeweza ikasimamia jambo hili.
Mheshimiwa Spika, nashukuru sana kwa kunipa nafasi ya kuuliza swali la nyongeza.

Mheshimiwa Spika, pamoja na majibu mazuri ya Naibu Waziri, lakini ningeomba ifamike kwamba tatizo hili sasa la taa za barabarani ni kubwa kwenye miji mingi. Tunafaidika na hali halisi tunavyoiona Dar es Salaam.

Je, Serikali inasema nini ikifahamu wazi kwamba Halmashauri, hizi hazina uwezo na pia ikijua kwamba haijui uwezo wake utarudi lini, kwa nini isichukue hili jukumu kama inavyofanya kwenye mipango mingine ya maendeleo ya miji ili itukwamue kwenye hili tatizo gumu la taa za barabarani?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Stephen Kazi,

Mheshimiwa Spika, kama nilivyosema jukumu hili liko katika Local Authorities tunachoweza kufanya sisi kama Wizar ni pale tutakapokuwa tumeombwa na vyombo hivi kushirikiana nao pamoja kujaribu kuona ni namna gani tutaweza kupata ufumbuzi kwa njia nyingine rather than sources kutoka kwenye Halmashauri zenyewe.

Mheshimiwa Spika, lakini kama nilivyosema kama Wizara hatuna Bajeti ambayo inatengwa kwa ajili ya shughuli kama hiyo. Kwa hiyo, itabidi tutegemee zaidi wahisani kutegemea sana mradi utakavyokuwa kama tulivyofanya kwenye miradi mingine.

Kwa kuwa maelewano kati ya Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi na Watendaji Kata (WEO) na Watendaji wa Vijiji (VEO) kuwa kiasi cha kodi wanayokusanya asilimia kadhaa itarudi Kijijini kwa ajili ya mishahara na matumizi ya vijiji na kwa kuwa mara nyingi Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi inapokea fedha hizo na asilimia ya wakusanyaji hailipi Watendaji hao, wanaambiwa tu waendelee kukusanya mpaka wamalize.
Je, huu ni utaratibu mzuri na unaofaa?
alijibu:-
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Profesa Simon Mbilinyi, Mbunge wa Peramiho, kama ifuatavyo:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, Watendeji wa Vijiji (VEOs) walikuwa wanatumiwa na Halmashauri kwa ajili ya ukusanyaji wa mapato mbalimbali ikiwepo kodi ya maendeleo. Serikali ilitoa maelekezo kwamba asilimia 20 ya fedha za mapato yanayotokana na kodi ya maendeleo yarudishwe katika Serikali za Vijiji ili zitumike kwa ajili ya miradi ya maendeleo. Watendaji wa Vijiji vile vile walipaswa kulipwa mishahara yao kutokana na chanzo cha mapato ya Serikali ya Kijiji kwa kuwa waliifanya kazi hiyo kama wakala. Baadhi ya Halmashauri hazikurudisha asilimia 20 ya mapato ya Kodi ya Maendeleo katika vijiji kwa ajili ya miradi ya maendeleo na mishahara ya Watendaji. Hivyo walisababisha manung’uniko mengi.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kutambua kwamba watendaji wa vijiji ni kiungo muhimu kati ya Serikali Kuu, Serikali za Mitaa na wananchi wanaofanya nao kazi za kila siku za kupeleka huduma na maendeleo katika ngazi ya chini hadi kufikia jamii, Serikali imeamua sasa kuwalipa mishahara watendaji hawa kuanzia Januari, 2004 kama ilivyokwishaelezwa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, nakubaliana kabisa na Mheshimiwa Profesa Simon Mbilinyi, kuwa utaratibu uliokuwa unatumika siyo mzuri na haufai. Ni kutokana na hali hii ndiyo maana Serikali imeamua kuwalipa mishahara watendaji hao ili kuondoa usumbufu na vile vile kuwatia moyo ili waweze kufanya kazi zao vizuri zaidi.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ni matumaini ya Serikali Kuu kwamba hatua hii italeta tija na ufanisi na msisimko wa utendaji miongoni mwa watendaji wa vijiji.

Mheshimiwa Spika, napenda kuishukuru Serikali kwa kufanya uamuzi wa busara wa kuwalipa maana kulikuwa na matatizo, hata kuna tarafa yangu moja mwaka 2002 watu walifukuzwa kazi wote kuanzia WEO na VEO kwa sababu walijilipa kabla kupeleka.

Kwa hiyo, wakati huu angalau kuanzia mwezi Desemba labda wangefanya utaratibu wa muda kwa wakati kabisa hela zao ndiyo wapeleke kwa bwana DED zinazokuwa za DED maana ziko mbili 20% hawa wachukue na 80 % wapeleke, kuliko kupeleka yote 100% halafu wenzao wanabana zote zile 20% hawatoi wanasema bado kalete zaidi, basi inakuwa tatizo. Kwa muda huu kuanzia Desemba wanaweza wakaweka utaratibu wa kushikizwa wale.
Mheshimiwa Waziri umeliewa hilo swali? Sawa ameelewa, Naibu Waziri.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Profesa Simon Mbilinyi, kama ifuatavyo:-
Mheshimiwa Spika, kuanzia sasa rai ya Mheshimiwa Mbunge na nina hakika ndiyo rai ya Wabunge vile vile kwamba fedha hizi zikatwe moja kwa moja pale zinapopatikana ile kuondoa kero hii ambayo ipo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, tutajaribu kuwaeleza hivyo kwa sababu kiutaratibu ndivyo inavyotakiwa kuwa, lakini tunajua kutokana na matatizo ya fedha wengi wamekuwa wakizipokea kwanza halafu wanapata tatizo la kujaribu kurejesha ile 20%. Lakini katika kipindi hiki ili kutoendeleza tatizo hili tutajaribu kuwaelekeza waone kwamba wanaweza wakalitekeleza hilo.

div.note: Na. 152. Nafasi ya Mwanamke kwenye Ngazi ya Uongozi

u.seg: Kwa kuwa Serikali kwa kupitia Sera ya Chama cha Mapinduzi ya mwaka 2002/2005 inatambua na kujali mchango wa mwanamke kwa Taifa hili na ndiyo maana
hata idadi ya Wabunge wa Viti Maalumu Bungeni imeweza kuongezwa kufikia asilimia 20 ya viti vya Bunge vinavyochaguliwa na wananchi.

Je, kwa nini Serikali isitumie utaratibu uliotumika katika kupata idadi ya Wabunge wa Viti Maalumu Bungeni ili kupata idadi ya kufaa kwa wanawake kwenye ngazi ya uongozi kama RC, DC, Makatibu na kwenye Taasisi mbalimbali za Serikali na zisizo za Serikali?

div.note: (k.n.y. WAZIRI WA NCHI, OFISI YA RAIS, UTUMISHI)

u.seg: Mheshimiwa Spika, napenda kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Ussi Yahaya Haji, Mbunge wa Chaani, kama ifuatavyo:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, zipo tofauti za msingi kati ya shughuli za utendaji na shughuli za uwakilishi. Shughuli za utendaji ni taaluma ambayo inahitaji maandalizi, mara nyingi ya muda mrefu. Hatua za kujenga uwezo wa uwakilishi wa wanawake zilianza mara baada ya Uhuru na zimeendelea kwa haraka zaidi.

Mheshimiwa Spika, hatua za kujenga taaluma ya utendaji zilianza kwa kasi ndogo na sasa ndiyo zimepewa msukumo zaidi na matokeo yake yameanza kuonekana. Aidha, vitengo vya jinsia vinaanzishwa katika kila Wizara ili kuratibu mikakati ya kujenga uwezo wa taaluma kwa wanawake ili waweze kushika nafasi za uongozi.

Mheshimiwa Spika, takwimu zilizopo zinaonyesha kwamba kuna Wakuu wa Mikoa wawili wanawake sawa na asilimia 10 ya nafasi za Wakuu wa Mkoa Tanzania Bara. Kati ya Wilaya 106 zilizopo, Wilaya 20 zinaongozwa na wanawake, sawa na asilimia 19. Aidha, Serikali imeweza kupandisha vyeo watumishi wanawake 61 katika ngazi ya juu sawa na asilimia 17 ya idadi ya wanawake waliopandishwa vyeo mwaka 2001. Kwa mfano, idadi ya wanawake waliokuwa kwenye wadhifa wa Katibu Mkuu iliongezeka toka watano ambao ni asilimia 17 hadi sita ambao ni asilimia 24. Hii inaonyesha kwamba Mheshimiwa Rais, anazingatia suala la jinsia kwa uteuzi wa Wakuu wa Mikoa na Wilaya pamoja na Watendaji Wakuu Serikalini.
Mheshimiwa Spika, nashukuru kwa kunipa nafasi ili niweze kuuliza swali moja la nyongeza.
Pamoja na majibu mazuri ya Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Kazi, Maendeleo ya Vijana na Michezo, naomba kuuliza swali moja la nyongeza.

Kwa kuwa makubaliano ya nchi za SADC kwamba ifikapo mwaka 2005 asilimia ya 30 ya wanawake wawe katika nafasi mbalimbali za uongozi. Kwa kuwa juzi NGO moja imefanya tathmini na kutueleza kwamba sasa hivi ni asilimia 21 tu ya wanawake, bado miaka miwili kufikia 2005. Je, Serikali inasema nini lengo la kufikia asilimia 30?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu la Mheshimiwa Hadija Kusaga, Mbunge wa Temeke, kama ifuatavyo:-
Namshukuru kwa takwimu alizotoa, lakini ni vema tukajijua nafasi ambayo tuliyopo Watanzania tukajilinganisha na nchi zingine. Hata katika SADC sisi ni wa tatu.

Kwa hiyo, unaweza ukaona jinsi ambavyo tunapiga hatua. Lakini vile vile nilivyosema ni kwamba kazi za uwasilishi zina mtiririko wake na kazi za utendaji za kitalaam zina mtiririko wake. Ili Mheshimiwa Rais aweze kuwateua akinamama waweze kushika nafasi, anazingatia mambo mengi kwa mfano ujuzi na hali ya kazi, uwezo wa kusukuma maendeleo na kuimarisha utendaji Serikali, elimu isiyopungua Kidato cha Nne, uzoefu wa kazi usiopungua miaka mitano, katika utawala, uchumi, siasa, maendeleo ya jamii na kadhalika, nafasi maalum kwa wanawake yote haya anayazingitia.
Mheshimiwa Spika, fikiria kwa mfano tuanze kugawana marubani wanawake na wanaume, unakwenda kupanda ndege ya mwanamke ambaye hajasomea urubani kwa sababu tu ni mwanamke haiwezekani.

div.note: Na. 153. Wanafunzi Waliochaguliwa kuingia Sekondari - Lindi

u.seg: (a) Je, ni wanafunzi wangapi Mkoani Lindi wamechaguliwa kuingia sekondari katika kipindi cha mwaka 2000 na 2001 lakini wakashindwa kuendelea na Elimu ya Sekondari kutokana na kukosa ada?
(b) Je, Serikali ina utaratibu gani wa kuwasaidia yatima na wasio na uwezo wa kuendelea na Elimu ya Sekondari?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Maria Watondoha, Mbunge Viti Maalumu lenye sehemu (a) na (b) kama ifuatavyo:-

(a) Mheshimiwa Spika, mwaka 2001 wanafunzi 1,180 walichaguliwa kujiunga na Kidato cha kwanza katika Mkoa wa Lindi katika hao wanafunzi 259 hawakuendelea na masomo. Mwaka 2002 wanafunzi 1,420 walichaguliwa katika hao wanafunzi 317 hawakuendelea na masomo. Siyo rahisi kwa Wizara yangu kusema kwa uhakika kuwa wanafunzi hawakuendelea na shule kutokana na kukosa ada. Inawezekana kwa baadhi ya wanafunzi sababu siyo hiyo ya kukosa ada kuwa ili tuwe na uhakika inahitaji uchambuzi wa hali halisi.

(b) Mheshimiwa Spika, kuhusu wanafunzi waliofaulu lakini ni yatima au wanatoka katika familia maskini waweza kusaidiwa ama na Halmashauri au na Serikali Kuu kutokana na mfuko wa shilingi bilioni 1.1 zilizotengwa na Serikali katika Bajeti ya mwaka 2002/2003. Mkoa wa Lindi ulitengewa shilingi 20,340,000/= za kusaidia wanafunzi wa aina hiyo. Utaratibu huu utaendelea mwaka huu.
Mheshimiwa Spika, nashukuru kwa majibu mazuri ya Mheshimiwa Waziri, lakini nina maswali mawili kama ifuatavyo:-

(i) Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kuwa katika mikoa mingi na hasa ile ya Kusini tatizo la Shule za Sekondari za Serikali ni kubwa na hivyo basi kupelekea watoto wengi yatima ambao wanafaulu mitihani yao kushindwa kupata nafasi katika Shule za Sekondari ni hivyo basi kupata nafasi katika shule binafsi ambazo zinatoa elimu hiyo ya Serikali.
Je, Wizara haioni kwamba ni wakati muafaka wa kuweza kufikiria kuwasaidia kuwalipia watoto hao ada hata kama wako katika shule za watu binafsi?

(ii) Kwa kuwa Mkoa wa Lindi ni miongoni mwa Mikoa makini katika nchi ya Tanzania na hivyo basi kupelekea Halmashauri kutokuwa na nguvu halisi ya kusaidia kulipia watoto hao ada. Je, Serikali haioni kwamba inatakiwa kuchukua nafasi ya kutoa upendeleo wa pekee kusaidia kukuza elimu katika mkoa huo?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu maswali mawili ya nyongeza, kama ifuatavyo:-

Kwanza, tatizo nililolieleza ukilinganisha na mikoa mingine Mkoa wa Lindi si kubwa kiasi ambacho Mheshimiwa anafikiri na tatizo ambalo na sehemu zingine lipo. Lakini kweli kwamba kuna watoto ambao wanapata matatizo ya kupata nafasi katika sekondari, kutokana na uchache wa nafasi wa shule zilizoko katika Mkoa wa Lindi na sehemu zingine. Jawabu lake kila siku tunazungumza Waheshimiwa Wabunge, tusaidiane kuhamasisha wananchi tujenge shule za sekondari za kutosha za wananchi ili Serikali ikisaidiana na wananchi, nafasi za kutosha ziweza kupatikana.

Lakini la pili ni kwamba tukianza kulipia na ada za watoto katika shule za watu binafsi, utakuta badala ya fedha zile kuendelea kwa watu walio wengi zitachukuliwa na watu wachache sana kwa ada za watu binafsi katika sekondari na katika shule za msingi ziko sana.
Kwa hiyo, ninachoweza kusema Waheshimiwa Wabunge jawabu hasa ni kuimarisha mkakati wa kujenga sekondari ili tuweze kuongeza nafasi na watoto wetu wote wapate kusoma.
Tatu, kwamba Halmashauri za Lindi ni maskini sana kwa hiyo, tutoe upendeleo maalum kwa ajili ya Mikoa ya Kusini. Ninachoweza kusema Mheshimiwa Mbunge,

kama ungepata takwimu za mapato kutoka Halmashauri hii hasa baada ya kuanza kufufua zao la korosho ukalinganisha na Halmashauri zingine, mimi ninakuhakikishia mapato yao hayako chini sana ukilinganisha na Halmashauri zingine, tena utakuta Halmashauri zingine ziko chini sana katika mapato. Ni kweli tutaendelea kugawa fedha hizo kutokana na uwiano kama jinsi Wizara ilivyotayarisha.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ahsante kwa kuniona.

Kwa kuwa Serikali imefuta ada ya shule za msingi na shule za sekondari bado haijafuta. Hivi kuna mantiki gani kwa sababu shule ya msingi watu ni wale na shule ya sekondari ni wale wale? Kule ada ni shilingi 2000/= tumefuta, huku shilingi 100,000/= hatujafuta, kwa nini Serikali isifute ada hiyo?
Naona ni swali jipya sijui, Waziri una majibu? Haya endelea kulijibu.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Yete Mwalyego, kama ifuatavyo:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, Serikali imefuta ada ya shule za msingi, lakini Serikali inayoongozwa na Chama cha Mapinduzi, huwa haitoi maamuzi yake bila kufanya utafiti wa kutosha. Nataka nikuhakikishie, kitendo cha kufuta ada shule za msingi hakikutokea over night, kazi hii tumeanza kuifanya tangu mwaka 1996, tunapiga hesabu zake, tunaangalia na uwezo wa uchumi wa Serikali unakwendaje. Tulipofika mahali tukaona kwamba sasa tuna uwezo ndiyo tukatangaza kufuta ada ya shule za msingi.

Tulipofika mahali tukaona kwamba sasa tunaweza tukatoa ruzuku katika shule za sekondari kwa watoto maskini tumeanza kutoa ruzuku kwa watoto ambao hawajiwezi. Lakini vile vile tunao mpango wa sekondari ambao unaandaliwa unaitwa SEMP sasa huu mpango utaangalia vile vile uwezo wa Taifa hili kuweza kufuta ada au kutokufuta ada. Lakini utatokana na utafiti thabiti tutakaofanya.

div.note: Na. 154. Mfuko wa Export Credit Guarantee Scheme

u.seg: MHE MASOUD ABDALLA SALIM (k.n.y MHE. HAMAD RASHID MOHAMED) aliuliza:-
Mheshimiwa Spika, tangu kuanzishwa kwa mfuko wa Export Credit Guarantee Scheme:-
(a) Je, ni wakulima na wafanyabiashara wangapi wamefaidika na mpango huo?
(b) Je, ni utaratibu gani uliotumika kuwapatia udhamini huo na masharti yake yakoje?
Mheshimiwa Spika, kabla ya sijajibu swali la Mheshimiwa Hamad Rashid Mohamed, naomba nitoe maelezo mafupi yafuatayo:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, mfuko wa Export Credit Guarantee Scheme ulianza rasmi tarehe 1 Julai, 2002. Utekelezaji wa mfuko huu unasimamiwa na Benki Kuu kama Wakala wa Serikali kwa lengo la kuufanya uwe asasi inayojitegemea baada ya kipindi cha mpito. Lengo kuu la mfuko huu ni kutoa kinga ya udhamini kwa mabenki ya biashara ili yaweze kutoa mikopo kwa wauzaji bidhaa nje kwa kuanza na wakulima, wasafirishaji wa mazao ya kilimo na Vyama vya Ushirika.

Mtaji wa mfuko kwa sasa yaani katika mwaka wa fedha wa 2002/2003 ulikuwa shilingi bilioni 6.5 ambazo kati ya hizo shilingi bilioni 5 zimetolewa na Wizara ya Fedha kwa njia ya Bajeti ya mwaka wa fedha 2002/2003 na shilingi bilioni 1.5 zimetolewa na Benki Kuu kutoka kwenye faida ya mwaka 2002/2003. Aidha, katika mwaka wa fedha wa 2003/2004 Serikali imetenga fedha maradufu kwa ajili ya mfuko huo. Mfuko unakadiriwa kuwa na jumla ya shilingi bilioni 13.1 katika mwaka ujao wa fedha.
Mheshimiwa Spika, baada ya maelezo hayo, naomba sasa nijibu swali la Mheshimiwa Hamad Rashid Mohamed, Mbunge wa Kuteuliwa, lenye sehemu (a) na (b) kama ifuatavyo:-
(a) Toka kuanzishwa kwa Mfuko wa Kinga ya Udhamini wa Mkopo kwa mauzo ya nje, Julai, 2002 Mfuko umedhamini mikopo iliyofikia shilingi bilioni 4.73 kwa mchanganuo ufuatao:-

Kwanza, maombi yawe yamefanyiwa tathmini na benki na ustahili wa mkopo kwa muuzaji nje udhibitiwe.

Mheshimiwa Spika, pili, mkopaji awe na mkataba wa makubaliano ya uuzaji bidhaa nje na mwenendo wa soko la bidhaa husika uwe unafahamika, tatu, maombi ya udhamini yawe kwa mkopo usiodi muda wa miezi 12 na nne, bidhaa husika ziwe zinazalishwa au kusindikwa Tanzania.

Mheshimiwa Spika, katika mwaka wa kwanza wa utekelezaji, mfuko ulilenga katika kuweka mazingira mazuri ya utekelezaji na taratibu za uhasibu (Accounting and Operations Manuals and Guidelines) ili mfuko uweze kuwa na uwajibikaji. Nia ya Serikali ni kuendeleza mfuko huu kwa kuuongezea uwezo kimtaji, kutoa mafunzo kwa wafanyakazi na kuandaa programu za upashanaji habari ili watu wengi sasa wakulima na wafanyabiashara kupitia Mabenki yao waweze kuuelewa na kuutumia.

Mheshimiwa Spika, pamoja na majibu mazuri ya Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri, naomba kuuliza swali moja la nyongeza. Je, ni matangazo gani yanayotolewa kwa wananchi ili waweze kuelewa kuwepo kwa mfuko huo na kuutumia kikamilifu?

Viwango vya Riba Zitolewazo na Mabenki

Kwa kuwa Sheria ya Benki Kuu ya Tanzania Na.1 ya mwaka 1995 inaipa Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BOT) Mamlaka ya kubuni, kusimamia na kutekeleza Sera za Fedha za Serikali ya Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania na kwa kuwa kifungu cha 5(2) cha sheria hiyo kinaelekeza na kuitaka Benki Kuu kuweka Sera bora ya fedha, mikopo na huduma za Benki zitakazohakikisha kukua bila ya kutetereka kwa uchumi wa Tanzania na kwa kuwa kifungu cha 7(1) cha Sheria hiyo kinaelekeza na kumtaka kuwa Gavana wa Benki Kuu afanye mashauriano ya mara kwa mara na Serikali juu ya Sera bora ya fedha; na kwa kuwa pale tofauti zinapojitokeza kifungu cha 7(2) kinampa Waziri mamlaka ya kumwagiza Gavana atekeleze sera inayoelekezwa na Serikali:-

(a) Je, ni kwa nini katika uchumi wa nchi yetu wenye mfumuko wa bei wa asilimia tano Benki Kuu imeruhusu riba inayotozwa kwa mikopo itolewayo na Mabenki ya Biashara (kwa wakopaji) iwe asilimia 18 hadi 30?

(b) Je, ni kwa nini Benki Kuu imeruhusu Mabenki hayo ya Biashara kuwalipa waweka akiba wa Tanzania riba ya akiba iliyo chini ya asilimia ya mfumuko wa bei, yaani riba ya asilimia 1.5 hadi asilimia 4.5 huku ikijua fika kuwa ni hasara kwa wananchi waweka akiba?

(c) Je, Waziri wa Fedha yuko tayari sasa kutumia mamlaka aliyopewa na sheria ya Benki Kuu ya Tanzania Na.1 ya mwaka 1995 kurekebisha hali hiyo ambayo inawafanya Watanzania walio wengi wasifaidi matunda ya kukua kwa uchumi wao na hivyo kuzidi kuwa maskini zaidi?
Mheshimiwa Spika, kabla ya kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Profesa Jumanne Maghembe, Mbunge wa Mwanga, naomba nitoe maelezo mafupi kama ifuatavyo:-

Suala la riba limekuwa na mjadala hapa Bungeni tangu Sheria ya Mabenki na Taasisi za Fedha ya mwaka 1991 yaani Banking and Financial Institutions Act 1991 ilipoanza kutekelezwa. Itakumbukwa kwamba mara baada ya Soko la Fedha kufanywa huria mwaka 1992, Sekta ya Fedha nchini imeruhusiwa kujiendesha kwa njia ya kibiashara yaani njia ya ushindani ndani ya mfumo wa soko huria.
Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Mabenki na Taasisi za Fedha ya mwaka 1991, Mabenki ya Biashara na Taasisi za Fedha ziliruhusiwa kujipangia viwango vya riba. Wateja wa
Mabenki nao wana uhuru kuwekeza amana zao au kukopa kwa kuangalia misingi ya riba zinazotolewa, ufanisi wa Benki na usalama wa amana zao.
Mheshimiwa Spika, baada ya maelezo hayo, sasa napenda kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Profesa Jumanne Maghembe, Mbunge wa Mwanga, lenye sehemu (a), (b) na (c) kama ifuatavyo:-

(a) Siyo kweli kwamba Benki Kuu imeruhusu Mabenki ya Biashara kutoza riba ya mikopo ya asilimia 18 hadi asilimia 30 kwa sababu uwekaji wa viwango vya riba vya Mabenki hauhitaji tena ruhusa ya Benki Kuu kama ilivyokuwa hapo zamani. Riba za amana na mikopo zinategemea ushindani ndani ya mfumo wa soko huria na Benki Kuu haina mamlaka yoyote ya kuingilia ushindani huo kwa nia ya kurekebisha viwango vya riba za Mabenki ya Biashara.

(b) Ni kweli kwamba waweka amana nao wameathirika kwa vile wanapoteza thamani ya fedha zao zinapokuwa Benki kwa kulipwa riba iliyo chini ya mfumuko wa bei. Lakini napenda kusisitiza tena kwamba viwango vinavyotolewa na Mabenki ya biashara kwa riba za amana ambavyo vipo chini ya mfumuko wa bei havikupangwa na Benki Kuu bali ni matokeo ya mfumo mzima wa soko huria unaozingatia gharama za kuendesha shughuli hii ya kibenki.

(c) Mheshimiwa Spika, Serikali haina nia ya kuandaa Sera ya Riba itakayodhibiti au kuwapangia wenye Mabenki viwango vya riba, ziwe na amana au za mikopo, kwani kwa kufanya hivyo, Serikali itakuwa imekiuka misingi ya soko huria na pia inaweza kusababisha hata ile mikopo inavyotolewa sasa ikosekane. Kwa sababu hiyo, wateja wanashauriwa kuzihama Benki zenye riba ndogo kwa wateja, kwani kuna ushahidi kuwa riba zinaendelea kushuka na kupanda kutegemeana na aina ya mteja na hali ya ushindani miongoni mwa Mabenki.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ninashukuru sana kwa kunipatia nafasi hii niulize swali la nyongeza.

(a) Kwa kuwa nchi zote duniani mpaka Marekani ambayo ni bepari mkubwa wanatumia viwango vya riba kama nyenzo yao ya kusimamia uchumi na kwa kuwa Sheria Na.5 ya Benki inaitaka Benki Kuu kuwa na Sera zinazosimamia uchumi ili uchumi wa Tanzania usitetereke na kwa kuwa akiba ya mtu mmoja mmoja ndio inajenga mtaji wa Taifa wa kuwekeza na riba zinazotolewa kwa uwekezaji huo ni ndogo sana;

Je, Serikali hasa Waziri wa Fedha atatumia lini uwezo aliopewa na sheria Na.5(2) kumlazimisha Gavana wa Benki Kuu aingilie kati ili Mabenki ya Biashara yawalipe Watanzania riba ya akiba inayozidi mfumuko wa bei?

(b) Kwa kuwa uzoefu umeonyesha kuwa wawekezaji wadogo wadogo katika vikundi vya uzalishaji mali wanakopa na kurudisha mikopo kwa asilimia 97 mpaka 100; je, BOT iko tayari sasa kuyalazimisha Mabenki na kwa kweli sitaki Waziri aniambie Benki Kuu haina uwezo, inao uwezo wa kisheria. Mabenki haya ya biashara….
Swali lako limeshaeleweka. Subiri majibu.
Limeeleweka kweli?!
Mheshimiwa Spika, nakubaliana na Mheshimiwa Profesa Jumanne Maghembe, kwamba nchi hasa Marekani kweli Mr. Green ni yeye kweli kama Mkuu wa Treasury ndio anarekebisha riba za Mabenki.

Lakini kama nilivyoeleza katika jibu langu la msingi, na kila mwaka Waheshimiwa Wabunge Serikali wakati tunaleta Bajeti yetu ya mwaka, Benki Kuu inatoa Monetary Statement ya Monetary Policy ya mwaka tunaokwenda wa fedha na mle kuna mapendekezo mbalimbali.

Mheshimiwa Profesa Jumanne Maghembe, kama amesoma Monetary Policy ya mwaka huu, utaona Governor wa Benki Kuu anaeleza kwamba kwa mujibu wa mfumo wetu wa ushuru utakavyokuwa mara hii, riba yetu tunaitegemea itakuwa kiasi hiki mpaka huku ili kuweza kuirudisha riba ifike kiasi fulani.

Ukiangalia ukurasa wa 42 wa statement iliyotoka wakati huu na inapotoka Waheshimiwa Wabunge inatakiwa iwe inajadiliwa pamoja na ile Budget Speech ya Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Fedha anayoitoa hapa ili tuweze kuangalia ni yapi hapa katika yale tunaweza kuyarekebisha ili tuhakikishe uchumi wetu na baadhi ya riba zetu twende hivi. Kufikisha Huduma ya Maji Jimboni Busega

Kwa kuwa ni Sera ya Taifa kuhakikisha kwamba inawapatia wananchi wake maji safi na salama kwa ajili ya matumizi yao na ya mifugo na kwa kuwa Jimbo la Busega liko kwenye mtandao wa Maji ya Ziwa Victoria na miradi mbalimbali ya maji, hivyo ni rahisi kusaidiwa na Serikali kupitia miradi hiyo:-

(a) Je, Serikali ina mpango gani wa kuwapatia maji wananchi wa Busega kwa kufufua miradi ya maji iliyojengwa siku nyingi na kuachwa bila kufanya kazi, kama vile ya Malambo ya Kijereshi, Mwangika, Nyangili, Shighala na Nyaluhande?

(b) Je, Serikali inayo taarifa ya kuwepo kwa miradi ya maji ya Nyaluhande, Nyashimo, Nassa, Kiloleli, Kalemera ya Mkula, Mwamagigisi, Ngasamo na Malili, ambayo kwa miaka zaidi ya 20 imebaki kama mapambo tu na kwamba inawaambia nini wananchi hao juu ya kuwapatia huduma hiyo?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Dr. Chegeni Masunga, Mbunge wa Busega, lenye sehemu (a) na (b) kama ifuatavyo:-

(a) Mheshimiwa Spika, katika kipindi cha mwaka 2002/2003, Wizara yangu kwa kushirikiana na Ofisi za Sekretarieti za Mikoa na Halmashauri za Wilaya, ilikamilisha zoezi la kutathmini miradi viporo katika Mikoa yote hapa nchini kama tulivyoahidi kwenye hotuba yetu ya Bajeti ya mwaka 2002/2003. Jumla ya miradi 794 ilibainishwa kuwa ni viporo au haifanyi kazi. Makisio ya gharama za awali za kukamilisha miradi hiyo ni shilingi bilioni 45.
Mheshimiwa Spika, miradi iliyoorodheshwa na Mheshimwia Mbunge wa Busega, katika swali lake ni miongoni mwa miradi 794 iliyobainishwa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kutokana na gharama za ukarabati wa miradi hiyo kuwa kubwa, Serikali haina uwezo wa moja kwa moja wa kuikarabati kwa wakati mmoja. Kazi hii itafanyika kwa awamu kwa kushirikiana na Halmashauri za Wilaya na wananchi wenyewe.

Mheshimiwa Spika, hata hivyo Serikali inaandaa mkakati wa kufufua na kujenga mabwawa na malambo nchi nzima. Kasi ya utekelezaji wa mkakati huo itategemea upatikanaji wa fedha. Aidha, katika mwaka 2002/2003 Wizara yangu ilitumia shilingi milioni tatu Wilayani Magu kwa ajili ya ukarabati wa Lambo la Kijereshi. Malambo mengine ya Mwangika, Nyangili, Shighala na Nyaluhande yatafanyiwa ukarabati kufuatana na mkakati unaoandaliwa.

(b) Serikali inayo taarifa ya kuwepo kwa miradi ya Nyaluhande, Nyashimo, Nassa, Kiloleli, Kalemera ya Mkula, Mwamagigisi, Ngasamo na Malili Wilayani Magu. Miradi hiyo ni miongoni mwa miradi ya maji iliyoorodheshwa na Wizara yangu kwa lengo la kufanyiwa ukarabati au kukamilisha ujenzi wake tukishirikiana na wananchi wa maeneo husika pamoja na Halmashauri za Wilaya na Wahisani.
Mheshimiwa Spika, namwomba Mheshimiwa Mbunge asaidie kuwahamasisha wananchi kuanzisha Mifuko ya Maji pale ambapo haijaanzishwa ili kusaidiana na Serikali mara fedha za miradi hii zitakapopatikana.
Mheshimiwa Spika, pamoja na majibu mazuri ya Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri, napenda kuuliza tu maswali madogo mawili ya nyongeza.

Kwa kuwa ni wazi kwamba Serikali imekiri kwamba imeshaanzisha programu ya kutathmini miradi ambayo imeshalala au miradi iliyosinzia; je, hawezi kutuambia kwamba katika mtazamo wa Bajeti hii kwamba ni nini kimetengwa ili kuweza kufufua miradi hii badala ya kusema kwamba zimefanywa tu tathmini ambayo hatujui itatekelezwa lini?

Pili, kwa kuwa scheme nyingi za maji katika nchi hii nyingi zimeshasimama na hazifanyi kazi lakini tunajua kabisa kwamba magonjwa mengi yanatokana na maji; je, Wizara bado ina mikakati gani au ina mpango gani maalum wa kufufua angalau zile scheme licha ya malambo?
Mheshimiwa Spika, kwanza swali la kiasi gani kimetengwa, nitamwomba Mheshimiwa Mbunge, asubiri tutakapoleta Bajeti yetu ili awe na matumaini.

Pili, miradi mingi iliyoharibika au ambayo haifanyi kazi au haikumaliziwa ilianzishwa kwa kutumia utaratibu uliokuwepo zamani enzi za miaka ya 1977 mingi yao ambayo ilikuwa inabuniwa kule kule Mikoani na ikitumia fedha zilizokuwa zinatengwa na Serikali kupelekwa Mikoani. Lakini baada ya hapo kwa sababu ya usimamizi mbovu, maeneo mengi yaliruhusiwa wakulima.

Kwa hiyo, matope mengi yakaingia kwenye malambo na sehemu za vyanzo vya maji na hivyo kuharibu uendelevu wa miradi hiyo. Lakini kama nilivyoeleza kwenye jibu la msingi, Serikali ikishirikiana na Halmashauri na wananchi, tumeanza kukarabati miradi hiyo. Nimesema milioni tatu zimetengwa kwa Kijiji alichokisema Mheshimiwa Mbunge, lakini labda nimkumbushe kwamba tulitoa shilingi milioni 12 kwa Vijiji vingine vya Matele ambako tumechimba lambo, Mwakiloba, Kitumba na Kitango. Kwa hiyo, mambo yake sio mabaya.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kuwa mradi wa Nyakagomba, Butundwe na Shankolongo na wenyewe ulianzishwa mwaka 1977; je, katika hizo shilingi bilioni tatu, mradi huo umefikiriwa kuweza kufufuliwa kwa sababu fedha nyingi zilitumika pale lakini haufanyi kazi?

Mheshimiwa Spika, nakubaliana na Mheshimiwa Faustine Rwilomba, kwamba mradi wa Nyakagomba ni kati ya miradi ambayo iliachwa bila kukamilika. Serikali imeshaanza kuifanyia kazi na nina hakika kwamba Mheshimiwa Mbunge anafahamu, juzi, juzi tumetoa shilingi milioni 20 ili kuanza kukamilisha mradi huo na pia tunatafuta fedha nyingine, mtaona wakati wa Bajeti kama tutaweza kuongeza fedha ili mradi huo ukamilike kwa ajili ya manufaa ya wananchi wa Jimbo na maeneo aliyoyasema Mheshimiwa Mbunge.
Mradi wa Maji Makong’ondera

Kwa kuwa Mradi wa Maji wa Makong’ondera uliopo Kata ya Likokona ni wa muda mrefu sana na kwa kuwa wakazi wanaoishi kuzunguka mradi huo wamekuwa wakishiriki kikamilifu katika ujenzi wa mradi huo na kwa kuwa Serikali bado haijaonyesha nia ya kuona mradi huo unamalizika na hivyo kuwaondolea wananchi husika kero ya ukosefu wa maji:-
(a) Je, Serikali inatamka nini mbele ya Bunge hili juu ya Mradi wa Maji wa Makong’ondera?
(b) Je, Mradi huo utakamilika lini na unakusudiwa kuhudumia maeneo gani utakapokamilika?
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Aridi Mwanache Uledi, Mbunge wa Nanyumbu, lenye sehemu (a) na (b) kama ifuatavyo:-

(a) Ni kweli kwamba kuna mradi wa maji wa bwawa juu ya mwamba (Rock Catchment Dam) katika Kijiji cha Makong’ondera. Mradi huu ambao ulibuniwa na kufadhiliwa na UNICEF ulianza kujengwa juu ya mwamba mkubwa uliopo Kijijini hapo mwaka 1990. Mradi huo ulikusudiwa kutoa huduma ya maji kwa Kijiji cha Makong’ondera. Ujenzi wa bwawa juu ya mwamba ulikuwa ni teknolojia mpya katika maeneo hayo.
Hata hivyo kuna visima vitano vya maji kwenye Kijiji cha Makong’ondera na kisima kimoja ndicho kinachotoa huduma ya maji wakati visima vingine vinne vimeharibika na vinahitaji matengenezo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, Serikali bado ina nia ya kutoa huduma ya maji ya kuridhisha kwenye Kijiji cha Makong’ondera. Ili kuwa na uhakika na teknolojia inayofaa, Wizara yangu kwa kushirikiana na Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Masasi inaangalia uwezekano wa kuendelea na mradi huo punde uchunguzi wa kutosha juu ya teknolojia hiyo utakapofanyika na fedha za kutekeleza mradi huo zitakapopatikana.

(b) Kama nilivyoeleza katika kipengele cha (a) hapo juu, uwezekano wa kuendelea na ujenzi wa mradi huo utategema taarifa ya kina ya uchunguzi kukamilika. Aidha, mradi huo ulikusudiwa kuhudumia Kijiji kimoja tu cha Makong’ondera.

Mheshimiwa Spika, nakushukuru kwa kunipatia nafasi ya kuuliza maswali mawili ya nyongeza. Kwa kuwa Rais Benjamin Mkapa, wakati wa Kampeni ya Uchaguzi Mkuu mwaka 2000 aliahidi pale Michiga kuwa angependa kuona mradi huu unakamilika katika kipindi hiki cha miaka mitano na kwa kuwa inavyoonekana ni kwamba ahadi hiyo haitaweza kutimia; je, Serikali kwa kushindwa kutekeleza ahadi hiyo, haioni kuwa haiwatendei haki Rais na wananchi wa Makong’ondera?
Pili, je, Serikali itawasaidia vipi wananchi wa Makong’ondera ambao wamechangia nguvu zao nyingi katika maradi huu?

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwanza napenda nimkumbushe Mheshimiwa Aridi Uledi, kwamba kipindi cha miaka mitano bado hakijakwisha. Kwa hiyo, kwa vile haikuwekwa timetable kwamba ni katika kipindi gani, ni kipindi cha miaka mitano, tayari kazi imeanza ya kuchunguza na kama nilivyoeleza kwenye jibu langu la msingi, kazi ilikwishaanza kwa kusaidiana na UNICEF na uchunguzi sasa hivi unafanywa ili kuendeleza huo mradi ili kupunguza matatizo kwenye maeneo hayo.

Swali lake la pili kwamba wananchi wamechanga fedha, napenda nimpongeze kwa kuwahamasisha kufanya hivyo, lakini pia waongeze bidii ili tuweze kufufua kwa kushirikiana nao visima vingine vinne ambavyo havifanyi kazi ili tutimize ahadi ya Mheshimiwa Rais aliyoitoa kama Mheshimiwa Mbunge alivyosema.
Hifadhi ya Selous Kutengeneza Barabara ya Ilonga

Kwa kuwa sasa hivi wananchi wa Wilaya ya Ulanga/Mahenge wanatembeleana na wananchi wa Wilaya ya Liwale, Mkoa wa Lindi kwa kutumia barabara ya kutembea kwa miguu kutoka Ilonga hadi Liwale wakisindikizwa na Askari wa Hifadhi ya Selous:-
(a) Je, Serikali ina mpango gani kutengeneza barabara hiyo Ilonga - Liwale?
(b) Kwa kuwa barabara hiyo inapita katika Mbuga ya Wanyama; je, kwa nini Hifadhi ya Selous isichukue jukumu la kutengeneza barabara hiyo?
Mheshimiwa Spika, kabla ya kujibu swali la Mheshimiwa Capt. Theodos Kasapira, Mbunge wa Ulanga Mashariki, naomba kutoa maelezo yafuatayo:-
Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kutambua umuhimu wa utamaduni wa wananchi wanaozunguka maeneo ya mapori ya akiba, Wizara yangu kupitia Idara ya Wanyamapori
mwaka 1987 iliruhusu wananchi kutoka Wilaya ya Liwale kwenda Ilonga Wilaya ya Ulanga kwa miguu kupitia ndani ya Pori la Akiba la Selous kwa ajili ya matambiko yanayoitwa ngende kwa lugha ya Kingindo.

inapendekeza vyanzo kama vile ada ya ukaguzi wa magari wa kila mwaka, usajili wa vyombo vya usafiri na kadhalika vipendekezwe kama vyanzo vya mapato ya Mfuko wa Barabara.

Kamati inashauri pia kuwa jukumu la Halmashauri kujenga barabara muhimu lihamie kwa TANROADS maana mapato ya Halmashauri yanatarajiwa kupungua sana kutokana na kupunguzwa kwa vyanzo vya kodi zenye kero.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pia napenda kuchukua nafasi hii kuwashukuru sana na kuwapongeza kwa nguvu kubwa wapiga kura wa Jimbo langu la Chonga na wenzao wa Majimbo mengine yote ya Pemba, kwa kung’ang’ania sawa sawa uamuzi wao wa
kukiunga mkono Chama cha CUF kwa kuwapigia kura nyingi wagombea wake na kukikatisha tamaa Chama cha Mapinduzi lakini zaidi kukipatia Chama hicho matunda kinayostahili.

Aidha, ninawapongeza Waheshimiwa Wabunge wote wapya katika Bunge hili Tukufu na kwa wale wenzangu kutoka Chama ngangari cha CUF, kwa kweli sasa kazi ndiyo inaanza na ndiyo kwanza jua la mabadiliko linachomoza.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pia ninachukua fursa hii kuwapongeza Waheshimiwa Wabunge wenzetu Mheshimiwa John Malecela, Mbunge wa Mtera na Mheshimiwa Anne Kilango, Mbunge wa Viti Maalum Wanawake, kwa kufunga pingu za maisha siku ya Jumamosi tarehe 28 Juni, 2003 pamoja na wengine waliofanya hivyo katika siku za karibuni.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Tanzania ni nchi kubwa sana na ufanisi wake wa kiuchumi na hata ule wa kisiasa na kijamii, unategemea sana mtandao bora wa barabara zinazopitika kwa mwaka mzima na pia uimara wa madaraja.

Barabara na madaraja bora ni sehemu ya muundombinu wa kiuchumi (economic infrastructure) na ni nyenzo muhimu kwa nchi yoyote inayotaka kupiga hatua mbele katika maendeleo ya kiuchumi, kijamii na hata kisiasa. Sekta ya ujenzi kupitia sekta ndogo ya barabara inao uwezo mkubwa mno wa kuibadilisha Tanzania kimaendeleo, kwa kutoa mchango mkubwa katika kuongeza Pato la Taifa la kila mwaka, kusaidia juhudi za kuufuta umaskini, kufutilia mbali tatizo la njaa, kuongeza mshikamano wa Kitaifa wa Watanzania na hata kuimarisha usalama wa Taifa zima.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, jukumu namba moja la Wizara ya Ujenzi katika nchi iliyo nyuma mno kimaendeleo kama Tanzania, ni lazima liwe ni kuhakikisha barabara zote nchini zipo katika ubora wa hali ya juu na zinatunzwa vema na kwa hali hiyo kupitika muda wote.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ni jambo la msingi kuhakikisha wazalishaji wa mashambani na viwandani wameunganishwa na walaji au masoko kupitia mtandao makini wa barabara na madaraja. Barabara bora ni sehemu muhimu ya mfereji au mkondo wa usambazaji wa bidhaa (distribution channel). Barabara bora pia humaanisha bidhaa bora na bei bora kwa walaji na wazalishaji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya hali ya uchumi ya Taifa katika mwaka 2002 kama ilivyotolewa mwezi Juni, 2003, zaidi ya asilimia 70 ya mizigo na abiria nchini husafirishwa kwa kutumia njia ya barabara na majini na asilimia 64 ya mizigo ya nchi jirani husafirishwa kwa njia hii. Takwimu hizi zinaonyesha bayana umuhimu wa barabara na madaraja katika kuujenga na kuusisimua uchumi na pia katika kuwatoa wananchi katika dimbwi la umaskini, kwa kuwaongeza makusanyo ya fedha za kigeni.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Wakala wa Barabara (TANROADS) tangu ulipoanzishwa tarehe 1 Julai, 2000, unalo jukumu la kuzifanyia matengenezo barabara zote kuu na za Mikoa zenye urefu wa km 35,000. Barabara za Wilaya na zile za Vijijini limeendelea kuwa ni jukumu la Halmashauri husika za Wilaya, Miji, Manispaa na jiji kupitia uratibu wa TAMISEMI.

Kwa sasa TANROADS wanawatumia zaidi Makandarasi kutengeneza na kujenga barabara kuliko matumizi ya vikosi vyake (Force Account). Ni wazi kabisa kwamba zipo faida nyingi za kuwatumia Makandarasi kama sehemu ya taratibu na mbinu mpya za kufanya kazi za Serikali, kwa maana ya outsourcing au contracting out, lakini mbinu hizo za kufanya kazi za umma kiuchumi zaidi, hufanikiwa sana katika zile Serikali na Taasisi za Kiserikali zisizo na dalili wala harufu yoyote ya rushwa.

Kwa mazingira ya Tanzania na kwa hali ya rushwa kama ilivyo sasa ndani ya Serikali na Taasisi zake, upo uwezekano mkubwa wa Makandarasi wa ovyo ovyo kupata kazi za ujenzi wa barabara na kuzijenga barabara hizo ovyo ovyo pia. Kwa mfano, barabara ya Shinyanga na Bariadi –Safiwi ilikuwa na usimamizi dhaifu kwa taarifa ya CAG ya mwaka 2001, barabara ya Kigoma Rural inasemekana kujengwa na Incompetent Staff kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya CAG na vivyo hivyo kwa Singida Rural Roads yaani Kititimo - Kinyamshindo na Singida – Gumanga.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kuwepo kwa vyombo kama Bodi za Usajili wa Makandarasi na Wahandisi au hata Baraza la Taifa la Ujenzi si kinga tosha dhidi ya rushwa ndani ya Wizara ya Ujenzi. Mkusanyiko mkubwa wa Taasisi mbalimbali ndani ya Wizara ya Ujenzi bado haujafuta tatizo la Makandarasi wasiofaa kupewa kazi na bado barabara nyingi nchini zinaendelea kujengwa na kutengenezwa kwa kiwango cha chini. Tatizo kubwa ni rushwa sugu (entrenched corruption) ndani ya vyombo vya utekelezaji na vile vya udhibiti. Taarifa za kila mwaka za CAG ikiwemo ya mwaka 2001 bado zinaonyesha kuwa tatizo la kukatiana ten percent ni kubwa sana ndani ya Wizara na kuna harufu ya rushwa. Mathalani doubtful payment yaani malipo ya mashaka yalikuwa milioni 12.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ufumbuzi wa matatizo haya si wa kupanga na kupangua safu za watendaji tu bali upo katika maamuzi ya kimsingi ya kisiasa. Kinachotakiwa ni utashi wa kisiasa ambao bado uongozi haujauonyesha. Tunaitaka Serikali itumie kwa makini fedha chache zinazopatikana kwa manufaa makubwa (value for money).

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kutokana na umakini mdogo wa TANROADS na Wizara kwa ujumla, Makandarasi wamekuwa wakichukua muda mrefu mno kumaliza mradi mmoja na tena katika hali ya kusuasua na ubora wa kazi unaotia shaka.
Kwa mfano, ujenzi wa barabara ya Wazo Hill hadi Bagamoyo ni km 43 tu na ujenzi wa barabara za Jiji la Mwanza ni km 58 tu, ni kati ya miradi iliyochukua muda mrefu sana na bado inaendelea.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pamoja na kuelekea mwishoni baada ya kelele nyingi za wananchi, ubora halisi wa barabara kwa mfano ya kona ya Wazo Hill hadi Bagamoyo ni wa kutia shaka. Si ajabu kusikia Mkandarasi wa barabara hiyo tayari amekwishapewa kazi nyingine kubwa zaidi mahali pengine nchini Tanzania na ana baraka zote za Wizara na TANROADS.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kuhusu kudhibiti uzito wa magari. Ni jambo la kusikitisha kuona kwamba Serikali imekuwa inafanya mzaha katika kudhibiti uzito wa magari na hasa katika barabara kuu. Njaa na tamaa za watu wachache zimekuwa zikiwabebesha Watanzania mzigo mzito wa umaskini unaoongezeka kila siku kwa:-
Kwanza, kwa kuchangia katika kuziharibu barabara na kwa hali hiyo kuanza kuhitaji matengenezo hata kabla ya muda ambao ungeliweza kustahili kiufundi na kwa hali hiyo kutumia fedha za nchi ovyo;
Pili, kuparaganyisha mfumo wa usafiri nchini kutokana na kufungwafungwa barabara kwa ajili ya matengenezo ambayo yasingelihitajika; na
Tatu, kuchochea ajali za barabarani na kwa hali hiyo watu wengi kupoteza maisha na mali kuharibiwa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa sababu inaonekana tatizo kubwa huenda ikawa ni rushwa kuliko vifaa, tunapendekeza Mheshimiwa Waziri aonyeshe kwamba yeye ni mtu wa wananchi kwa kumaliza kabisa kero hii. Hatua madhubuti na za kweli zinaweza kabisa kumaliza tatizo la rushwa katika eneo zima la udhibiti wa uzito wa magari.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, uaskari wa miavuli si urembo wa maneno kwenye hotuba na utoaji wa miito tu, bali ni pamoja na kuwajibisha na kuadabisha kwa haraka tena bila kumtazama mtu usoni kila inapobidi ili kuinusuru nchi na raslimali zake muhimu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kuhusu uuzaji wa nyumba za Serikali. Wakala wa Majengo Tanzania (TBA) tangu ulipoanzishwa mwaka 2002 kufuatia Sheria ya Bunge Na. 30 ya mwaka 1997, umejitwisha zaidi jukumu la kuuza nyumba 3,000 za Serikali zinazotakiwa kuuzwa kwa wanaozitumia, kwa kasi ya umeme hadi kufikia Mei, 2003 nyumba 2,979 zilikwisha kopeshwa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, zoezi zima la kuuza nyumba za Serikali limetokea kuzua malalamiko mengi na halionekani kuungwa mkono na wananchi wengi wa nchi hii. Kuliko kuziba masikio na kuendelea kulifumbia macho zoezi hilo, Serikali inashauriwa kufanya yafuatayo:-
Kwanza, kuiangalia upya sera nzima ya kuuza nyumba za Serikali kwa lengo la kuona kama zipo sababu za msingi sana na zisizo na mbadala za kuendelea na zoezi hilo.
Pili, kujibu kwa kina hoja kadhaa zinazotolewa na watu mbalimbali na makundi tofauti ya watu kuhusu uhalali na sababu (rationale) za kuwepo zoezi hilo.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tatu, kuna taarifa kuwa kabla ya kuuza nyumba hizo, zimefanyiwa ukarabati kwa fedha za Serikali na kuuzwa kwa wahusika ambao ni viongozi kwa bei ya kutupwa.

Mheshimiw Naibu Spika, kwa azma na Sera ya ukweli ya CCM, tunaitaka Serikali kufanya tathmini ya kina juu ya hali ya nyumba hizo, ukarabati uliofanywa, bei iliyouzwa na wahusika waliouziwa na taarifa hiyo iwasilishwe kwa Kamati husika na hatimaye hapa Bungeni.

Aidha, nne, tuna taarifa kuwa nyumba mpya za Serikali zinajengwa maeneo ya Mbweni nje kabisa ya eneo la katikati ya Jiji zaidi ya km 40. Je, Serikali imefikiria gharama itakayoingia kwa viongozi wa Serikali kukaa huko na kila siku kusafiri zaidi ya km 80 kwa magari ya Serikali gharama itakayolipwa na walalahoi ambao hata mlo mmoja kwa siku hawana uhakika nao? Isitoshe magari yatachakaa mapema na kuleta gharama ya ziada kwa matengenezo yao au kwa ununuzi wa magari mengine mapya.

Tano, tunaitaka Serikali kusitisha haraka zoezi hilo hadi hapo maswali yote yenye utata yatakapojibiwa. Tuna mashaka kuwa kuna maslahi ya watu binafsi badala ya maslahi ya Taifa katika suala hili. Nyumba na mali mbalimbali za Serikali na hasa zile zisizohamishika, si sawa na tai ya shingoni ya mtu binafsi au kilemba cha mtu binafsi. Kumpa mtu binafsi mali ya Watanzania wote, ni wazi kunahitaji ruhusa na ridhaa ya Watanzania wote na si vinginevyo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sita, tatizo la kuuza nyumba hata tukiendelea kulifumbia macho linaashiria wingu nene la rushwa ya kitaasisi kama inavyohalalishwa hakuna mantiki kukarabati nyumba kwa milioni 100 na kuuza kwa milioni 40 kama si rushwa ya Taasisi. Ni kwa msingi huo, Kambi ya Upinzani inaitaka Serikali iache ukali, ijibu maswali ya Wabunge kwa niaba ya wananchi na iwasilishe taarifa kamili juu ya hali ya mali ya Watanzania kwa wawakilishi wao yaani Bungeni.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, NBMM ni taasisi ya zamani kabisa ikiwa sasa ina umri wa karibu miaka 22 tangu ilipoanzishwa kupitia Sheria ya Bunge Na.9 ya mwaka 1981. Bodi hii ndiyo msimamizi na mwendelezaji namba moja wa fani za uboharia na ugavi katika Tanzania. Pamoja na umri wake mkubwa, bado bodi hii haijafanikiwa kuepusha rafu katika eneo la ugavi, manunuzi na uboharia ndani ya Serikali na ni jambo la wazi kwa watu wengi kwamba:-

(a) Bado upo ununuzi wa vifaa hewa na hata huduma hewa unaofanywa na Maafisa Ugavi wa Serikali mathalan taarifa ya CAG 2001, inaonyesha stores not taken on ledgers ya mamilioni ya shilingi kwa ajili ya Bailey Bridge wala hakuna taarifa ya kupokelewa wala ya wapi ilikopelekwa.

(b) Bado vipo vifaa vinavyonunuliwa na Serikali vikiwa na ubora wa chini na bei zilizozidishwa kwa makubaliano maalum kati ya wauzaji na Maafisa Ugavi wa Serikali kutokana na shinikizo la kukatiwa ten percent ambayo ni rushwa ya wazi kama ilivyo kwenye taarifa ya CAG ambako katika Barabara za Singida zilizotajwa hapo juu, Culverts hazikuwekwa kabisa japo zimelipiwa.

(c) Upo udanganyifu wa aina kadhaa wenye nia ya kuiibia Serikali pamoja na waajiri wengine ambao unafanywa na Maafisa ambao wanatambulika na bodi, mathalani taarifa ya CAG inaonyesha upotevu wa wazi wa shilingi 27,507,617 kwa mwaka 2000/2001 ama kwa makusudi au kutokana na taaluma ndogo ya Maafisa ugavi.
(d) Fani nzima ya ugavi imeanza kupoteza heshima yake mbele ya jamii na inaanza kufananishwa na rushwa, kutowajibika, uzembe, wizi, ubadhirifu na kadhalika.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, inapendekezwa hatua zifuatazo zichukuliwe kwa lengo la kunusuru kuzama kwa taaluma nzima ya ugavi na uboharia:-

(i) Ni lazima sheria nzima iliyoanzisha NBMM iangaliwe upya kwa lengo la kuona sheria hiyo ni kwa vipi inaenda sawa na mazingira ya sasa ya kisayansi na kiteknolojia, kitaaluma, kijamii, kiuchumi, kisiasa na kadhalika.

(ii) Bodi nzima ni lazima sasa ipigwe tochi upya na ni lazima Serikali iondokane na tabia yake ya siku nyingi ya kuteua wajumbe wa bodi mbalimbali ikiwemo bodi hii kwa vigezo vya kimwenzetu badala ya umahiri wa kazi inayohusika. Siasa iachwe katika uteuzi wa watu wa kusaidia vyombo vya kitaalamu na vizingatiwe vigezo vya kitaalamu na ujuzi tu.

(iii) Ufundishaji wa masomo yanayotahiniwa na bodi hiyo katika vyuo mbalimbali ni lazima uangaliwe upya. Wanafunzi wanaonekana kuikimbia fani hii ya ugavi na wanaoitaka wanachowazia ni ten percent zake tu wakati wa kufanya manunuzi. Mitihani ya Kitaifa inayoendeshwa na NBMM imekuwa na mazonge kadhaa na watahiniwa wamekuwa wakifeli kwa kiwango kinachoshtua!

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, bado jengo la Chimwaga mjini Dodoma halijaonekana kuwa na matumizi bora ya kiuchumi hata baada ya kurudishwa Serikalini kutoka CCM. Jengo hilo linaonekana kuwa bado ni mradi wa kimaonesho na kimikogo tu (white elephant project) na kuna kila sababu kwa Serikali kueleza matumizi sahihi ya sasa na hata ya baadaye ya jengo hilo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ieleweke wazi kwamba fedha nyingi sana za wakulima na wafanyakazi wa Tanzania zilitumika kujenga jengo hilo na bado zipo gharama za kuendelea kuwa na jengo hilo katika hali yake ya sasa kwani linaendelea kushughulikiwa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Kambi ya Upinzani inaishauri Serikali ambayo inasifika sana kwa hatua zake za ubinafsishaji ilibinafsishe pia jengo hilo kama itapata ridhaa ya kufanya hivyo kutoka kwa wananchi ili liendelezwe na wawekezaji wengine hasa wa ndani ya nchi kwa lengo la kuwa na ukumbi wa Kimataifa wa mikutano au kuendelezwa na kuwa Chuo cha Elimu ya Juu kupitia mashirika yasiyo ya Kiserikali, dini na mengineyo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Wizara ya Ujenzi inalo pia jukumu la kuimarisha usalama barabarani kwa kushirikiana na vyombo vingine kama Jeshi la Polisi, Mamlaka Kuu ya Leseni za Usafirishaji, Shirika la Viwango la Taifa na kadhalika. Ili kuimarisha usalama wa raia barabarani, Wizara ifanye haraka yafuatayo:-
(a) Iangalie kwa makini wimbi la wizi wa nguzo na vifaa mbalimbali ambavyo vimechorwa alama za barabarani kwa lengo la kukomesha kabisa tabia hiyo;
(b) Idhibiti wimbi kubwa la wizi wa mabomba na vyuma vinavyokinga madaraja hasa katika maeneo ya nje ya miji;
(c) Ipambane vikali na madreva kila siku wanaogonga vibanda vya kusubiria mabasi ya abiria hasa barabara ya Morogoro kati ya Mlandizi na eneo la Fire, Jijini Dar es Salaam;

(d) Ishirikiane na TBS na Mamlaka Kuu ya Leseni kuliangalia kwa makini wimbi la kubadilisha malori makubwa (hasa yale ya Scania) kuwa mabasi baada ya kujengewa bodi na pia malori aina ya Fuso pia kubadilishwa kwa kujengewa bodi na kuwa mabasi ya abiria waendao Mikoani. Lengo liwe ni kuona kama viwango husika vya mabasi maalum kwa abiria wa safari za mbali vimezingatiwa na wajengaji mabodi ili kuepusha ajali.
(e) Ihakikishe basi lolote lile linalotumia barabara lina milango ya dharura isiyo na utata wala mkanganyo;
(f) Ishirikiane na Jeshi la Polisi pia Mamlaka ya Leseni ili kudhibiti rushwa katika utoaji wa leseni za udreva na hasa kwa madreva wa mabasi ya abiria yaendayo Mikoani na yanayotumika mijini.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, bado Wizara ya Ujenzi inaendelea kuongozwa na falsafa ya zimamoto katika menejimenti nzima ya vivuko. Kivuko kipya hakiletwi mpaka watu wafe kwenye maji mfano Mto Kilombero. Pia matengenezo ya mara kwa mara yenye lengo la kuziba ufa ili kuepuka kujenga ukuta hayafanywi mpaka kivuko kizimike engine katikati ya safari na hasahasa mpaka wananchi wafe au wataharuki.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, imekuwa ni tabia sasa ya viongozi wa Serikali kupenda kujivisha nyuso za simanzi wakati wa kusoma hotuba zao kwenye mazishi, kuwazika Watanzania wanaokufa kwa makosa ya kizembe ambayo yalikuwa na kila
namna ya kuyazuia kama viongozi wa Serikali wangekuwa makini katika majukumu yao.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali isipende kukusanya fedha za wananchi tu kwenye nauli za vivuko. Ni muhimu ihakikishe usalama wa wananchi ndani ya vivuko hivyo na ikitokea ajali ya kizembe iambatane na wahusika wote tangu juu hadi chini kuwajibishwa kisawasawa. Ni lazima fidia ya kweli kweli ilipwe kwa wote walioathirika.

Kwa mwaka huu wa fedha 2003/2004, kwa vivuko vya Magogoni, Kigongo, Busisi na Bugenzi pia Kome kule Mwanza, pamoja na Kilombero (Morogoro), Pangani (Tanga) na Ilagala (Kigoma), Serikali itakusanya zaidi ya shilingi bilioni 1.7. Kwa mapato hayo, Serikali inatakiwa kweli kununua life jackets kwa kila abiria kwa kila kivuko na si kupiga porojo kwa hotuba tamu zenye ahadi za life jackets kila mwaka bila life jackets zenyewe kupatikana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, asilimia 75 ya barabara zilizo katika mtandao wa barabara za Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki zipo Tanzania. Jumla ya fedha zilizoombwa kwa ajili ya Tanzania kutoka wa wafadhili mbalimbali ni Dola za Kimarekani milioni 1,460 kwa ajili ya barabara zenye urefu wa km 4,880. Barabara zilizo chini ya Jumuiya hiyo ni bahati kubwa kwa Tanzania na kinachotakiwa kufanyika sasa hivi ni kuitumia vema nafasi hiyo. Lakini kwa ushirikiano kati ya Wizara na Wabunge wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki, upo uwezekano wa kujenga hoja mbele ya Kenya na Uganda kwa lengo la kuongeza idadi ya barabara za Jumuiya zilizo ndani ya Tanzania.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ni jukumu la Waheshimiwa Wabunge wenzetu wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki wanaoiwakilisha Tanzania, kusimama kidete kujenga hoja zitakazoisaidia Tanzania kuimarisha mtandao wake wa barabara toka barabara kuu hadi za vijijini, hatua kwa hatua. Ushirikiano wa nchi na nchi na hata ule wa kikanda na Kimkoa, huongozwa zaidi na sababu za kimaslahi hasa yale ya kiuchumi na kimkakati. Kupata barabara bora kupitia Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki ni hitaji muhimu la kiuchumi na kimkakati la Tanzania.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kumekuwa na harakati nyingi za ujenzi wa nyumba kubwa katika miji mikubwa na hasa mfumuko wa ujenzi wa majengo na ghorofa katika eneo la Kariakoo Jijini Dar es Salaam. Upo wasiwasi miongoni mwa wananchi wengi kuhusu ubora wa kiufundi wa majengo hayo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali ni lazima ifuatilie viwango vya ujenzi wa maghorofa yanayojengwa harakaharaka katika maeneo yetu ya miji na hasa Dar es Salaam kwa lengo la kuepusha matatizo katika siku za usoni na hasa kulinda maisha ya Watanzania. Majengo hayo lazima yafuate viwango vinavyotakiwa, hasa kuzingatia maslahi na usalama wa watumiaji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kama ilivyoelezwa hapa na Mwenyekiti wa Kamati, inashauriwa uwepo mkakati wa makusudi wa kulilinda daraja muhimu la Mto Rufiji kutokana hasa na unyeti wake wa kiuchumi na hata kiutawala wa nchi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hili si daraja la kulindwa na makampuni binafsi ya ulinzi bali litafutiwe walinzi wa uhakika na wananchi wa maeneo ya jirani wahamasishwe kushiriki katika ulinzi wa mali hiyo muhimu kwa Taifa letu.

Mr. Speaker Sir, Honourable Members for this House, my first message to this House and all the People of Tanzania is a message of good wishes from the people of Malawi. This message is reinforced by our strong belief in Malawi that the people of our two countries are really one people, members of the same family separated only by artificial borders. Our culture is pretty much was the same, so too our history, our challenges and our aspirations.

My presence today is in itself a reflection of the excellent relationship that exist between Malawi and Tanzania, relations that go back many, many years. Let it be said that all of us in this House and your counterparts in the Malawi Parliament who are in fact just siting open Parliament last week, have a duty to ensure that these relations grow from strength to strength.

Our bonds must grow from strength to strength because only through unity and a common front can we in this part of the world have a chance of achieving the development which is always on every Honourable member’s lips in this House. Only by working together can we uplift the lives of our people.

This was the conviction expressed by the pioneers of Pan-Africanism, including such names as Ghana’s Kwame Nkurmah, Ethiopia’s Haile Sellassie and a great son of this soil on which I stand today by the name of Late Mwalimu Julius Kambarage Nyerere.

Mr. Speaker Sir, please excuse me if I will found person I regard Mwalimu as one of my personal inspirations, which is why immediately after my Government took power in 1994, I invited him to come to Malawi. It had not been possible for the Mwalimu to visit Malawi before that, because of some minor problems he had with my predessor, His Excellency the Life President then of our Republic, but this is a matter I have no wish to dwell on, only to say that we Malawians also had major problems with our departed Life President.

Mwalimu Nyerere’s name always comes to mind whenever we discuss the problems facing Africa today. His contribution was not so much because he provided answers to big challenges we face but rather because more than most African leaders, he posed the hard questions and kept the big issues on the agenda.

It was the Mwalimu’s articulation of this agenda and his attempts to carry it out that engaged most Africans, both those for or against his views. Nyerere’s principled stand on decolonization and his own role in the liberation of Tanzania are well known.

Not only did he provide support and a home to virtually all the major liberation Movements in Africa, but he also provided refuge to many who fled from Banda’s oppressive regime in Malawi. At enormous cost to his country, Nyerere stood firmly on sanctions against both South Africa and Rhodesia and in the process, lost financial support from the United Kingdom.

He was one of the most articulated spokespersons of the liberation movement and was constant and tireless in reminding the world of the terrible crime of apartheid. But more importantly for our current topic, that Nyerere was an ardent advocate of regional cooperation, going to the extent of postponing the independence of Tanganyika to wait for her neighbours in the African Community.

Let me remind the House the on 12 February, 1979 addressing the Ministerial Conference of the Group of 77 under the theme of Unity for a New Order, the Mwalimu Said and I quote: „What we have in common is that we are all, in relation to the development world, dependent not interdependent Nations.
Each of our economies has developed as a by product and a subsidiary of development in the industrialized North, and is externally oriented. We are not the prime
movers of our own destiny. We are ashamed to admit it but economically we are dependencies semi colonies at best not sovereign states.

He also made a very unique observation which I find significant even today, namely that what amount of cooperation a country can expect to get from the rich countries depends on whether those countries thins it is in their interest to help pull a country put of poverty. For instance the United Stated has found that it is necessary and in its interest to help Mexico because if Mexico’s economy were to collapse, then its unemployed would flock to the United States. But Mwalimu noted that this does not apply to Africa, South of the Sahara and I quote.

„Africa South of the Sahara is isolated. That is the first point I want to make. South of the Sahara is totally isolated in terms of the configuration of developing power in the world of the 21st Century on its own. There is no centre of power for self interest, it is important to develop Africa. Not North America not Japan, not Western Europe. There’s no self-interest to bother about Africa South of the Sahara. Africa South of the Sahara is on its own”. End of quote.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, during the conferences of African Nations held in the early years of our independence, the economic problems to be faced by independent Africa featured prominently. There was a consensus that the smallness and fragmentation of post-colonial African National markets constituted a major obstacle to sustaining meaningful economic operations.
The importance of achieving sustainable economic development through cooperation was therefore recognized even at this very early stage.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, today, the challenges of African Development are compounded by the globalization and liberalization of the world economy, greater economic integration of financial and money markets, and a shift towards the creation of large trading and economic blocs. These developments offer not only challenges but also timely opportunities to Africa and there is a need to broaden the concept of regionalism and to rethink African’s regional integration strategy.
The past two decades have witnessed a resurgence of regional economic integration groupings at a global level.

The fundamental objectives for the formation of Africa’s regional economic communities, such as the East African Economic Community to which Tanzania belongs, derive from the need of the member countries in such arrangements to achieve, individually and collectively, higher levels of development that would otherwise prove elusive.

The Treaty establishing the African Union makes it very clear that the realization of such a Union depends critically on the performance of the regional economic unions, which are the building blocks of the continental body.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, if we are honest, we must admit that although Regional Cooperation and integration have been on Africa’s Development agenda for quite a long time while so far the approach has produced very limited results for the continent, considering the protracted efforts of Governments, Institutions and other players. African economies remain largely disconnected from one another, relatively underdeveloped and indeed most are stagnant.

The overall integration process has been fraught with many difficulties, not least of which are the lack of a concerted approach and direction, dispersed interventions and intentions and sometimes confused responsibilities among the many of players.

I have seen these problems at close range, because I have chairman of both COMESA and SADC. The difficulties I have referred to point to the need for more effort and commitment to promote Regional integration, as this remains the key solution to overcoming economic problems.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, ultimately, the African Union should be seen as a means of transforming the continent from a fragmented region of least developed and developing states into a strong and a unified federation of develop Nations.

Indeed the current emphasis on integration is what led the formation of the African Union, with the New Partnership for African’s Development which now known as NEPAD as the major supporting International initiative and I hope it can work.

The long years of the Pan African movement brought about the OAU. Thus, the founding of OAU is the evolutionary outcome of earlier regional and Pan-African gatherings. The founding fathers, the Heads of State and Government of 32 independent African countries met on May 25, 1963 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia to lay the base for a common front.

A Charter establishing the movement for African unity was adopted and subsequently ratified by the participating Governments. Under the charter, a permanent body named the Organization of African Unit was launched.

Pan-Africanism represented a reaction against the oppression of the black man and the racial doctrine that marked the era of slavery. It evolved from a movement of self-assertion and resistance to enslavement in those early days, to organized forces with cultural and political claims. After the Second World War, it took on a continental dimension and came to represent the quest for continental unity.

The continued survival of this movement and its functional relevance to this day underlines the validity of the political, economic and strategic consideration behind Pan- Africanism. Thus from the beginning the need for economic cooperation was identified and was also incorporated into Article 2 of the Charter, which stated that: „The Members
States shall coordinate and continue harmonize their general policies especially in the vital sectors of the economy, transport and communications”.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, Honourable Members of the House, as we pay tribute to Pan- Africanism and its fallen and living heroes we must remind ourselves that the agenda Africa set for itself is far from finished. I repeat this is far from finished. Every honest observer must admit that Africa’s economic performance has been and continues to be dismal, very dismal in deed.

Most of our economies are marked by negative or zero growth rates. Africa’s lag vis-a-vis the rest of the world is astronomical and embarrassing. The continent of Africa is now so marginalized that our share trade is a shameful 0.7 percent.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, whenever we talk about the well being of mankind today, the subjects of globalization stand side by side with conflict and poverty because they are intertwined and work together in their impact on society.

We are all agreed that intrastate conflict and wars are severely undermining Africa’s efforts to develop and that peace is a prerequisite to development. And I stand by this statement and I do hope that His Excellency our President in Tanzania when you become the Chairman of SADC in August this year, you take this challenge because is very very important.

But you must make sure that our region remain peaceful. The wars that we have seen amount of money that are spent to buy weapons of different kind instead of using the money in building schools and roads, should stop absolutely.

Now when it comes to the causes of these conflicts there are two major lines of thought. The dominant theory tends to emphasis the internal factors within a Nations as the root causes of conflict. These factors have to do with lack of economic growth on the one hand, and poor governance, including the denial of human rights and lack of freedoms on the other.

The corresponding solutions offered for these challenges are, as might be expected economic growth and good governance. If only the economy could be made to grow, if only the ruling party could be made to behave according to certain rules, then there would be peace and bliss throughout the continent, so the argument goes.

This is a very attractive and indeed acceptable analysis, but its principal fault is that it does not adequately analyze the international or global, dimension of the economic challenges and conflicts.
Mr. Speaker, Sir, Honourable Members, the social philosophy of the emerging global economic order is that of individualism, survival of the fittest and winner takes it all.

As the wind of globalization continues to blow through Africa, rendering the world more selfish and greedy and as long as we continue to accept Western culture as superior over our own, the cultural glue that held African societies in one piece will continue to get weaker.

The alternative perspective argues that while poverty is at the root of conflict and violence, and that human rights do indeed get violated these thins do not simply exist but are created by the manner which a country or region is integrated into the global economy. The basis of this integration is the unequal exchange between what the country or region contributes to the global economy and what it gets in return.

The new world order is founded on the ideology of the free market, but behind the free market are big monopolies that control the markets from tobacco to sugar to diamonds and beef, our own beef. Violence and conflicts are rooted in a region’s continued impoverishment by such a system.

Let us look for a while at Africa’s crippling debt burden and this very important. In 1995, according to United Nation Secretary-General Koffi Annan, Africa managed to pay $25.4 billion of the $86.3 billion of the interest, it owed to its creditors. In other words we could not even service our debt. Thus, instead of reducing its debt stock Africa actually increased it by a further $60.9 billion. The debt goes on piling year after year.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, Honourable Members, the question you might ask, why do the creditors appear to be satisfied with receiving only about a third of the interest owed to them on past debt? One explanation is that, they cannot afford to ruin the potential market in Africa for their goods and for their future investments, which is what would happen if they forced Africa to make the debt payments in full.

Honourable Speaker, to deal with this situation our cooperating partners, as we like to call them, have created a concept of sustainable debt that can be paid our without ruining the economy. It is the same thing really, as sustainable poverty I may call, keeping poverty in Africa at a level where people do not actually fall down dead so that they can continue to be part of the equation.

Let us think these to the bigger pictures. We should link these to the bigger picture. There are two important related questions, how do you the debts arise in the first place. How do you the debts arise in the first place, and why is very little in fact done to remove this formidable barrier to Africa’s development, when it is generally recognize that without removing the debt burdens there is no hope, there is no hope for development in Africa?

These questions become important when we make the link between debt and economic development, and between the lack of economic growth and conflict, we can argue that one of the significant causes of conflict in Africa is the struggle for survival in a situation of scarce resources.

The debt imposes severe strain on these resources and therefore makes perpetual conflict inevitable. The struggle for resources, whether in Africa or anywhere else, manifests itself in the struggle to state power. Any analysis of the governance and the state with democracy in Africa cannot afford to leave this factor out of the equation. I repeat what I said at the beginning, namely that the problems of democracy in Africa are to some extend at least a reflection of the economic environment that individual states find themselves in, and this turn a function of their relations with the global context.

Further Honorable Speakers, given the historical division between ethnic groups in Africa (exploited and made worse during the colonial rule, as in some of the countries of Greats Lakes, for example) the conflict can trigger civil war and even genocide. Hence here then we have one root cause of conflicts in Africa. Although it is by no means the only cause the debt burden carries a heavy responsibility for civil strife and war in Africa. It follows therefore that its cancellation can be a major move to sustainable development and peace in Africa.

However, it is not in the rule of game of global financing to the simply write off debt because such a move can have serious consequence of the financial system. Also, even if debts were written off today, they would spiral up again given other factors including the inherently unequal economic relations between Africa and the industrialised world.

Of course, as I have indicated, every aspect of conflict and peace cannot be pinned down to debt. Complex matters cannot be reduced to single factors. But given the linked nature of all these factors, it is difficult to separate the significance of one factor from that of others.

The principal reason of debt is unequal trade relations between Africa and the rich countries. Now, of course Africa’s debts have many complex political and economic causes. Take the debts left by Mobutu in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Everybody now accuses Mobutu of corruption and bad governance.

With better use of borrowed money and with a more accountable system of governance, the DRC should not have had to face the present problem of debt. But the real question is; why did the rich countries go on putting money into Mobutu’s coffers in the full knowledge of his corruption and undemocratic governance? Why was good governance not an issue at that time, and why is it an issue now? One may be asked.
The same argument can be applied to Western talk about mismanagement of borrowed funds. These factors are relevant and important. Of course.

Corruption is a problem in Africa and it must be fought, and indeed I am glad to note that the fight against corruption is very much at the center of your agenda here in Tanzania. But it will help our quest for lasting solutions if in our analysis we
also asks why these issues were not raised in earlier times, and question is why now?

Furthermore, Mr. Speaker, Sir, given the historical relationship between Africa and the West, it is ironic that our former colonial masters are today preaching the virtues of freedom to us. Former colonizers and ex-slave-owners have made a virtue of championing political freedom.
Yesterday’s oppressors appear to be today’s liberators, fighting for democracy, human rights and free market economies throughout the world.

The irony does not escape us Africans that the nations that are clamoring for respect for human rights and fundamental freedom are at the same time pushing for globalization and economic policies that encourage the abuse of these rights, including the denial of the right to economic equality.

Nor does it escape Honorable Speaker, Sir, that these nations do not themselves always practice what they preach to us, as we have seen for example on the issue of farmer subsidies. I am sure when President Benjamin William Mkapa, try to suggest the order is out of the motion to use the Parliamentary word.
Mismanagement and corruption aside, the truth has to be faced that the most significant reason for Africa’s economic woes is unequal trade relations between Africa and the industrialized countries.

There is a structured relationship between the products of exported by Africa and those imported, that ensures that Africa has to go on producing more and more of the same to get less and less of the imports from the rich countries. They talk about the WTO Globalization what have view. If we do not our self as countries

Mr. Speaker, Sir, encourage our manufacturer base, how can we compete on the International Market. We must have a base all what trying to do is to find market themselves. We must sweat and sweat, work and work, we must compete at equal opportunities. Then to meaningful is question of Globalization they talk about.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, I put it to this Honorable House, that Africa is weak and poor today because its rich natural resources are taken away at a fraction of their value. The terms of exchange between Africa’s natural resources and the West’s capital and knowledge intensive technologies continue to remain the basis for a vast seepage of next value out of Africa and into its Western trading partners, and this is most unfortunately.

In other words, at no win situation for Africa is embedded within the current system of international relations and international trade. Instead of sustainable development, what Africa is getting is a sustainable continued poverty our in our

continent. I give you an example Malawi got independence 1964 as he speak now sixty four percent of our people lives below poverty life. After forty years of our independence. I was telling the President that during our change 1994 I went home and told my mother say lets go and vote self what shall I do going to vote for. So well, we changing from one party to that other, ooh she said of course you can’t got vote from me. People would want to see Mr. Speaker Sir, some change what is it that, we become independent about in case of Tanzania those days. Because those are very issues.

The only way out of this very seriously situation lies in the kind of solidarity which Mwalimu Nyerere and the founders of the OAU envisaged a long time ago. Africa must unite and speak with voice. As Kwame Nkrumah said in those days, and I quote: „No Independent African State today by itself has a chance to follow an independent course of economic development, and many of us who have tried to do this have been almost ruined or have had to return to the fold of the former colonial rulers. This position will not change unless we have a unified policy working on the continental level.” End of quote.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, allow me to use this opportunity to touch briefly on the issue of Multiparty Democracy in Africa. After what the Continent has gone through, namely colonialism, he said one party dictatorship, life presidency, apartheid and civil wars, it is now generally believed that a country can only be called a Democracy if it practice multi-party politics.
I think one of the merits of multipartyism is that it safeguards against dictatorship and enables a nation to benefit from a variety of political and economic
ideas. But I must hasten to add that multiparty politics, if no properly handled, can turn us into hostages of never -ending bickering and acrimony.

While diversity is the essence of Democracy, it should not be allowed to undermine the strong sense of patriotism that is critical for nationhood. Narrow party interests should not play into the hands of foreign interests and should be exploited at the expense of national interests.

Someone once said that if you put two Britons on the moon, I do not whether is possible they will form an exclusive Gentlemen’s Club; but if you put two Africans on the moon, they will form three political parties one for each, and the third one of ensure continuous strife.

We have all a blessed Multiparty Politics, but this should not obviously recently to be rocked in never ending first to tell each other, to pieces at the expense of national building. After all we are all African’s we are all Tanzanians. The coming of Multipartyism should do not been inherently among and between us at all.

If he go to Britain you will find Tony Blair and the Opposition eader drinking whisky together. Why not? Here you cannot drink Kibuku together. Why not? He said we respect you, if you are going to deal with constructive issues, which can help your governments and we will really listen.

I am saying this in the presence of Deputy Leader of Opposition whoes presence is very virtal. Sometime I become worried and wonder where were going. The President was telling me that he just appointed these Commissioners I think why not, personally why not. They must give opportunity it is a time. Women empowerment why not, given them opportunity and Mr. Speaker Sir, once you give a woman chance to run business, she does it better.

I would tell you what, I also get a push from the First Lady of Malawi his my wife, all the time she says to me: „You are do not doing much about women, you must do it”. I am trying to do my best. Mr. Speaker, Sir, the menace of HIV / Aids, if not checked, will render fruitless all the efforts we are making in nation-building. Fight against HIV / Aids should be especially targeted at the youth, the future leaders of our countries. If our young people dies, our nations would die too. Let me caution, however, that when talking about HIV / Aids to the masses, it is important that we who hold position of leadership and this is important should lead by example.
